backend/main.mo: Motoko canister defining types and in‑memory lists for categories, styles, orders, and inquiries, including a date comparison helper for sorting orders.
feature_evidence.json: Feature report documenting the logo‑replacement update with involved files, components, and test references.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing responsibilities of all frontend files, including layout, catalog, branding, and state modules.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base file defining OKLCH color tokens, theming variables, and light/dark mode styling rules.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component wiring all site sections with an intersection observer to track the active section.
frontend/src/components/branding/BrandLo: Displays the uploaded logo image with fallback to LogoPlaceholder on load error.
frontend/src/components/branding/LogoPla: Scissors‑icon placeholder component shown when no valid logo is available.
frontend/src/components/catalog/CatalogS: Fetches catalog data, supports category filtering, handles loading/error states, and enables selecting a style to scroll to the order form.
frontend/src/components/layout/Section.t: Reusable layout wrapper giving consistent padding, container width, and background variants.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteFoote: Footer showing brand info, navigation shortcuts, contact links, and attribution with UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/navigation/SiteH: Header component with scroll-aware styling, mobile menu toggle, and smooth-scroll navigation.
frontend/src/components/navigation/TopCo: Simple top bar displaying clickable phone and email from contact config.
frontend/src/components/order/OrderNowSe: Order form section handling style selection, measurement inputs, validation, and order submission.
frontend/src/components/order/SizeGuideP: Collapsible panel showing measurement instructions and a basic size reference table.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: About section highlighting tailoring features with icons and descriptive text.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Contact section with contact info cards and a validated inquiry submission form.
frontend/src/components/sections/HomeHer: Hero banner with background image, tagline, and buttons that smooth-scroll to order or catalog sections.
frontend/src/config/contact.ts: Exports contact details including phone, email, address, and business name.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, and refreshes dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, loading and managing user identity and login state using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines catalog fetching and order/inquiry submission hooks using the backend actor and React Query.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom OKLCH theme variables for light and dark mode with premium color scheme.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/src/state/selectedStyle.ts: Zustand store for tracking the user-selected style from the catalog.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, animations, and plugins with OKLCH-based design tokens.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing site requirements, features, architecture notes, and development state.
